mapper.select: select w.lot_id, w.kind, w.no from ( select n.lot_id, 'NCR' as kind, n.ncr_no as no from qms_ncr n where n.lot_id in #{id} and n.status in ('OPEN', 'PENDING') union all select l.lot_id, 'CONTAIN', c.contain_no from qms_contain_lot l join qms_contain c on c.contain_id = l.contain_id where l.lot_id in #{id} and l.released_at is null and c.status = 'OPEN' ) w order by w.lot_id, w.kind, w.no
